items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: At 17:00 EST, daily floor = max(balance, equity) − 3% of initial balance. Example: $5K account, equity $5,100 at reset → floor = $4,950. If balance > equity at reset, floor = balance − $150.

items.label: Max Trailing Drawdown
items.detail: Trails from highest closing trade balance. Locks at starting balance once 5% profit is reached. After lock, a fixed 1% buffer is added — you cannot withdraw all profit and then breach. Resets daily at 17:00 EST (daily DD only).

items.label: Guardian Shield
items.detail: Funded stage only. If total open PnL reaches −1% of initial balance, all trades are auto-closed. Soft breach: 1st = profit split drops to 50%. 2nd = account breached. Effective since 3 Mar 2025.

items.label: Consistency Rule
items.detail: One trading day's profit must not equal or exceed 15% of total profits in the payout period. No account termination — must keep trading until highest day falls below 15%. Example: $1,000 best day → need ≥ $6,667 total to request payout.

items.label: Min Holding Time
items.detail: Trades closed in under 2 minutes may be flagged as tick scalping — prohibited and may result in account closure.

items.label: Margin Usage Limit
items.detail: Margin usage ≥ 80% on any single trade = gambling rule violation. Strategy must reflect disciplined risk management, not all-or-nothing behavior.

items.label: Inactivity Limit
items.detail: At least one trade must be placed every 30 calendar days. Failure = account breach.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: News trading is permitted. Be aware of slippage and account sync delays during high-impact events — outcomes cannot be guaranteed.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: No restrictions on holding positions overnight.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: No restrictions on holding positions over the weekend.

items.label: Hedging
items.detail: Hedging strategies are permitted.

items.label: Martingale
items.detail: Martingale strategies are permitted.

items.label: Stop Loss
items.detail: No mandatory stop loss. However, if most trades have no SL, the risk team may require you to implement one.

items.label: EAs / Copiers
items.detail: Expert Advisors and trade copiers permitted for your own strategy. VPN/VPS allowed but must not be used to bypass copy/group/signal trading rules.

items.label: HFT / Arbitrage
items.detail: Tick scalping, HFT, latency arbitrage, reverse arbitrage, hedge arbitrage, delayed data feeds, platform freezing exploits — all prohibited. Account terminated without compensation.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Starting split. Drops to 50% after 1st Guardian Shield breach. Account breached after 2nd.

items.label: Min Trading Days
items.detail: 5 profitable days (≥ 0.5% each, non-consecutive) required before payout. No maximum trading days.

items.label: Payout Cap
items.detail: Single payout maximum is 5% of initial balance per cycle.

items.label: One Payout Only
items.detail: Instant Starter is limited to ONE payout per account. After first payout the account is closed. One account per trader.

items.label: Max Capital
items.detail: Maximum account size for Instant Funding Starter. One account per trader.
